definitions.gloss: getting something new, having something newly made
definitions.explanation: The act of acquiring a new item, especially clothing, furniture, or equipment, often to replace something old or worn out. Implies purchasing or having something custom-made.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新調|しんちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新調|しんちょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got new shoes in time for the entrance ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新調|しんちょう}⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧、いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: I went around several stores, thinking about getting new curtains to replace the old ones.

notes:
USAGE:
{新調|しんちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ implies purposefully acquiring something new, often with a sense of replacing something old or preparing for an occasion. It is most commonly used for clothing, accessories, and household items.
Unlike simply "buying" (⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧), {新調|しんちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ carries the nuance of replacing something or preparing something fresh for an occasion. It can also imply having something custom-made rather than buying off the shelf.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新調|しんちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get a new suit
- ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新調|しんちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get a new kimono
- ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新調|しんちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get new furniture
- ⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新調|しんちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get a new uniform
